list.title: Workflows
list.description: The workspace's automations, suggested by your AI agent or built by hand.
list.emptyDescription: Name your first workflow above to create it.

statusHint.waiting: Waiting for a human decision or a delay.
statusHint.failed: A step failed: see the details below, then retry.
statusHint.paused_budget: Monthly AI budget of the workspace reached. Raise it or add your AI provider key in Settings: the run will resume on its own.
statusHint.canceled: The run was canceled before it finished.

describe.monthly: On the {day, selectordinal, one {#st} two {#nd} few {#rd} other {#th}} of every month at {time}

blocks.description: Search for a block to add to the workflow.

decide.label: AI decision
decide.description: The AI picks one of the declared branches and explains why.

run.label: AI agent
run.description: The AI follows an instruction and can read or update objects.

extract.label: AI extraction
extract.description: The AI extracts structured fields (text, number, date, list…) from a text.

condition.label: Condition (yes / no)
condition.description: Checks one or more rules on the record (relations included): continues on Yes if they are true, otherwise on No.

set.label: Set values
set.description: Creates named values (text, number, variables) to reuse in the following steps.

transform.label: Reshape data
transform.description: Extracts fields from an object (e.g. an event's content) under new names.

formatter.label: Format a value
formatter.description: Transforms text, numbers or dates without AI (case, extraction, rounding, date format, lookup table…).

date.label: Compute a date
date.description: Formats a date, adds a duration or computes the gap between two dates.

emit.label: Emit an event
emit.description: Publishes an event that can trigger other workflows.

request.label: HTTP request
request.description: Calls an external URL and returns the response.

approve.label: Human approval
approve.description: Pauses the run until it is approved or rejected, with an optional timeout.

aggregate.label: Compute on a list
aggregate.description: Counts items or computes a sum, average, minimum or maximum, overall or per group.

dedupe.label: Remove duplicates
dedupe.description: Removes duplicate items from a list (by a field or the whole item).

filter.label: Filter a list
filter.description: Keeps the records of a list that match a condition.

limit.label: Keep the first items
limit.description: Keeps a limited number of items from a list.

map.label: Transform a list
map.description: Turns each item of a list into an object.

sort.label: Sort a list
sort.description: Sorts the items of a list by a field.

loop.label: Loop
loop.description: Repeats a sequence of steps for each item of a list.

call.label: MCP call
call.description: Calls a tool on a configured MCP server.

create.label: Create a record
create.description: Creates a record in an object of a database.

delete.label: Delete a record
delete.description: Moves a record to the trash. Restorable for 30 days, then purged.

get.label: Read a record
get.description: Reads a record by its id.

map.label: Copy a record
map.description: Copies a record to an object in any database, field by field.

merge.label: Merge records
merge.description: Merges duplicates into one record: fields, relations and timeline, all or nothing.

search.label: Search records
search.description: Searches the records of an object with a filter.

transact.label: Batch writes
transact.description: Applies several creates, updates and deletes in one transaction.

update.label: Update a record
update.description: Updates one or more fields of a record.

upsert.label: Create or update a record
upsert.description: Upsert by unique field (email, domain…) or external id, without duplicates.

send.label: Slack message
send.description: Sends a message to Slack through an Incoming Webhook URL.

error.label: Stop with an error
error.description: Stops the workflow with an error message; the error shows up in the error center.

switch.label: Switch
switch.description: Routes to a branch based on a field's value: one case per value, then Otherwise.

wait.label: Wait
wait.description: Pauses the run for a duration.

until.label: Wait until a date
until.description: Pauses the run until a specific date and time.

emit.label: Send a webhook
emit.description: Sends a signed payload to a URL.

run.label: Run another workflow
run.description: Runs another workflow and waits for its result, or continues without waiting.

a11y.nodeDefault: Press Enter or Space to select a node, then the arrow keys to move it. Escape to cancel.
a11y.nodeKeyboardDisabled: Press Enter or Space to select a node.
a11y.edgeDefault: Press Enter or Space to select a link.

editor.help: Click a step to configure it. A new step is linked to the selected step. To link manually, drag from the dot under the trigger or a branch to the dot at the top of a step, or use “Next step”. To remove a link, click it and press Delete.

trigger.label: Trigger
trigger.runFailedHelp: This workflow starts when a run of the watched workflow fails: handy for alerts or automatic fixes. The workflow name and error message are available in the steps.
trigger.scheduleWithObject: At each scheduled time, the workflow runs once for every record of this object.
trigger.scheduleWithoutObject: Without an object, the workflow runs once at each scheduled time.
trigger.objectHelp: The workflow runs for a record of this object: its data is available in every step.
trigger.eventHelp: An event is a named signal sent by your app (API), by the “Emit event” step of another workflow, or by the MCP. The workflow starts every time this name is received.

stepForm.includeHelp: Checked linked records become a list usable by “Filter list” or “Transform list”.
stepForm.conditionTitle: Continue on “Yes” if all these conditions are true
stepForm.noList: No upstream list. Add “Search records” before this step, or “Get record” with an included relation.
stepForm.keepWhere: Keep records where all these conditions are true
stepForm.columnsHelp: Each record becomes an object with these columns (e.g. for an email, a table, an AI).

ai.noSecret: No API key saved in this workspace yet.
ai.required: Required: choose the provider, model and key this block runs with.

recordFields.chooseFirst: Choose the record or object first.

webhook.label: Webhook
webhook.none: No webhooks: create one via the MCP ({tool}).
webhook.help: Send a test from the provider (e.g. Cal.com): the received payload shows up here. To avoid triggering anything during the test, use the test URL above: it saves the sample without running the workflow. Or paste a JSON sample.
webhook.detected: {count, plural, one {# field} other {# fields}} detected in the sample.
webhook.runsOn: The workflow runs on the resulting record; the full payload stays available in every step via {code}.

empty.title: No runs
empty.description: Runs of this workflow will show up here.

runs.summary: {count, plural, one {# step run} other {# steps run}}
